rationale: Outputs stay reproducible, consistent with the single source of truth, and traceable to the data and engine version that made them.
statement: Every output (reports, lists, datasheets, drawings, calculations, rules.md, ledger.md) is produced by an engine in `engine/engines/` run with `python -m engine run <engine>`. Nothing in `output/` or `internal_deliveries/` is created or edited by hand, by a script outside the engine, or by an AI writing files directly. If no engine produces a needed output, build or extend the engine (with template and test) first.
title: Engines are the only way to generate outputs from the database
